intro: Describing a building, a sculpture or a painting, and placing it in its style.
p.fachada.glosa: façade, the front of a building
p.fachada.consejo: The «fachada» is the «face» of a building: what you see from the street. It is written with ch.
p.arco.consejo: In Romanesque the arch is round; in Gothic, pointed. «Arco» is also a violin bow.
p.cúpula.consejo: It has an accent because the stress falls on the third-to-last syllable: CÚ-pu-la. Theatres and museums have them.
p.románico.glosa: Romanesque, the style of the 11th and 12th centuries
p.románico.consejo: It changes with the noun: «arte románico», «torre románica». It has an accent on the a.
p.gótico.glosa: Gothic, the style of the 13th to 15th centuries
p.gótico.consejo: It stresses the third-to-last syllable, hence the accent. Barcelona has a «Barrio Gótico», its old town.
p.barroco.glosa: Baroque, the style of the 17th and 18th centuries
p.barroco.consejo: The rr is strong. It is also said of anything very ornate: «un estilo barroco».
p.mármol.consejo: It ends in l but the stress comes earlier, hence the accent: MÁR-mol. Plural: «mármoles».
p.estatua.consejo: It sounds es-TA-twa: u and a make a single syllable. No accent is needed.
p.óleo.consejo: A painting is done «al óleo». The stress falls on the first syllable: Ó-le-o.
p.lienzo.consejo: The z sounds like English th: LYEN-tho. Sometimes «lienzo» means the painting itself.
p.retrato.consejo: An «autorretrato» is a portrait of oneself: «auto-» means «of oneself».
p.paisaje.consejo: It is written with j and the stress falls on the second syllable: pai-SA-he.
p.obra maestra.consejo: Plural: «obras maestras». It is said of a painting, a book, a film or a building.
p.restaurar.consejo: You restore a painting, a building or a piece of furniture. The stress is on the last syllable: rres-tau-RAR.
b1.texto:
**Buildings.** A building has a **fachada** (façade), columns, **arcos** (arches), towers and sometimes a **cúpula** (dome). Three styles come up again and again in Spain: **románico** (11th–12th centuries: thick walls and round arches), **gótico** (13th–15th: height and pointed arches) and **barroco** (17th–18th: movement and lots of ornament).

**Sculptures.** A **estatua** is **de mármol** (of marble), **de bronce**, **de madera** or **de barro**. The material always takes **de**.

**Paintings.** They are painted **al óleo** (in oils) or in watercolour, on a **lienzo** (canvas). There are **retratos** (portraits), **paisajes** (landscapes) and abstract or contemporary styles.

**Describing.** To place things: **en el centro**, **a la izquierda**, **al fondo**. To give an opinion: an **obra maestra** is an artist's best work. If something is worn out, it gets restored: **se restaura**.
b2.f0.texto: What style does the façade of this palace have?
b2.f1.texto: The dome and the decorations on the door are typical of the Baroque.
b2.f2.texto: Is the statue in the courtyard made of marble?
b2.f3.texto: It is bronze, although it looks like stone.
b2.f4.texto: This oil portrait is the masterpiece of our collection.
b2.f6.texto: A local artist painted it on a huge canvas.
b2.f7.texto: I like the landscape at the back more.
b4.titulo: The facts of a work: «se» + verb
b4.texto:
To give the facts of a building or a painting, use **se** + verb (**reflexive passive**). The verb agrees with what is built, painted or kept:

- **Se construyó** el castillo / **se construyeron** las murallas.
- **Se pintó** el retrato / **se pintaron** los paisajes.
- **Se conserva** en un museo / **se conservan** en un museo.

There is no need to say who did it. For the date use **en** (**en 1656**) or **hace** (**hace poco**, **hace ocho siglos**).
b4.e0.texto: The castle was built eight centuries ago.
b4.e1.texto: This statue was restored a few years ago.
b4.e2.texto: The canvases are kept in the city museum.
b5.f0.texto: At dawn, the mist rises from the river and tangles itself in the arches of the old Romanesque bridge.
b5.f1.texto: Its grey stones keep the cold of the night and smell of wet moss.
b5.f2.texto: Higher up, the city wall raises its thick walls above the hill.
b5.f3.texto: Inside, the narrow streets keep the cool shade of other centuries.
b5.f4.texto: Above a gateway in the square, a round arch frames the sky like a painting.
b5.f5.texto: In the main square, the old merchants' exchange rises towards the sky with its tall windows and pointed arches.
b5.f6.texto: Next to it, the Baroque palace shows off a façade full of columns, statues and decorations.
b5.f7.texto: The afternoon sun gilds the dome and stretches the shadow of the statues across the ground.
b5.f8.texto: The neighbours cross the square without raising their eyes to so much beauty.
b5.f9.texto: Only a little girl stops and draws the arches and the dome in her notebook.
b6.o0.refuerzo: Gothic is recognised by its pointed arches and its height.
b6.o1.refuerzo: Yes: Romanesque has thick walls and round arches.
b6.o2.refuerzo: Baroque looks for movement and ornament, not thick walls.
b6.pregunta: Which style has thick walls and round arches?
b7.o0.refuerzo: Yes: the material of something is said with «de»: de mármol, de bronce.
b7.o1.refuerzo: «En» shows place, as in «en el museo», not material.
b7.o2.refuerzo: «Con» shows company or instrument; the material takes «de».
b7.pregunta: Which word goes before the material?
b8.frase: Al fondo se ve un palacio gótico
b8.traduccion: In the background you can see a Gothic palace
b9.o0.refuerzo: A landscape paints countryside, sea or mountains, not a person.
b9.o1.refuerzo: The canvas is the cloth you paint on, not the kind of painting.
b9.o2.refuerzo: Yes: a portrait is a painting of a person's face.
b9.pregunta: What do you call a painting of a person's face?
b11.o0.refuerzo: Yes: «el lienzo» is singular, so the verb is too: «se conserva».
b11.o1.refuerzo: That form is plural and needs «los lienzos».
b11.o2.refuerzo: «Conservas» is the «tú» form; here the subject is the canvas.
b11.pregunta: Which verb form completes the sentence?
b12.o0: la mejor obra de un artista
b12.o0.refuerzo: Yes: a masterpiece is the best thing an artist has made.
b12.o1.refuerzo: A copy imitates another work; it is not an artist's best.
b12.o2.refuerzo: An unfinished work is a sketch, not a masterpiece.
p.estilo.consejo: Ends in -o, so it is masculine: «el estilo».
p.adornos.consejo: Comes from «adornar», to decorate. Its family is «adornar» and «adorno».
p.típicos.consejo: Here it agrees with «los adornos», plural: «típicos» ends in -s.
p.bronce.consejo: The c and z sound like «th» in Spain: «bronce» is BRON-the.
p.colección.consejo: Ends in -ción, so it is feminine and the stress is on -ón.
p.pintó.consejo: Past form of «pintar» (to paint). «Pintó» is for he, she or you formal.
p.artista.consejo: «Artista» is used for both men and women: «el artista» or «la artista».
p.construyó.consejo: From «construir»: the i becomes y in the third person, so «construyó».
p.siglos.consejo: The g sounds like «g» in «go» before i, so SIG-los.
p.restauró.consejo: «Restaurar» is to repair an old thing. Here the verb is in the past.
p.lienzos.consejo: In Spain the z sounds like «th»: lyen-THOS.
p.conservan.consejo: Plural form of «conservar». Note the stress falls on SER.
p.enreda.consejo: «Enredar» comes from «red», net. Think of something caught in a net.
p.arcos.consejo: The c before o sounds like «k»: AR-kos.
p.guardan.consejo: The u is silent after g in «gua» only when followed by e or i; here the u is heard: gwar-DAN.
p.huelen.consejo: From «oler»: the o becomes «ue», so «huelen». The h is silent.
p.musgo.consejo: The g before o is a hard «g», like «go».
p.muros.consejo: «Muro» ends in -o, so it is masculine: «el muro».
p.colina.consejo: Smaller than a «montaña». The stress is on LI.
p.sombra.consejo: Feminine, with «la sombra». The b here sounds soft, like «v» between vowels.
p.otros.consejo: Before a plural noun, it is «otros». Before a singular, «otro».
p.enmarca.consejo: «Enmarcar» comes from «marco», frame. Think of a picture in a frame.
p.lonja.consejo: In Spain, the j sounds like a strong «h»: LON-kha.
p.mercaderes.consejo: «Mercader» is an old word for merchant. Its family is «mercado».
p.exhibe.consejo: The x sounds like «ks»: eks-I-be. The stress is on I.
p.columnas.consejo: Feminine plural. Remember the stress: ko-LUM-nas.
p.estatuas.consejo: «Estatua» is feminine: «la estatua». The -ua at the end sounds as one syllable.
p.levantar.consejo: The v sounds like «b»: le-ban-TAR. The stress is at the end.
